_meta.purpose: Horizontal coverage — the StatementMode 'quick takes' surface (Polis-lite), entirely unseeded today. Short propositions (10–200 chars) the crowd votes agree/pass/disagree on. ADDITIVE.
_meta.LOADER CHANGE REQUIRED: New seedStatements(): insert entity_statements (body, author_id, entity, optional source_comment_id) + statement_votes. vote_summary here is AUTHORED display (agree/pass/disagree counts) — synthetic votes confer no standing, same rule as authored bridge scores. Some statements are promoted from a comment (source_comment → entity_statements.source_comment_id).
_meta.rules: 10–200 chars enforced; vote ∈ -1(disagree)|0(pass)|+1(agree). Officials don't vote on statements (users only).
